info.title: Deskohub Workspace customer API
info.description: Authenticated by the Better Auth session cookie that /api/auth sets. Every request carries the x-deskohub-client: workspace-customer-api header; a request without it, or from another site, gets 403.

200.description: The account's data archive as a ZIP file.

Content-Disposition.description: Serves the archive as an attachment named by the day it was made, as `attachment; filename="deskohub-account-data-<YYYY-MM-DD>.zip"`.

200.description: The issued invoice as a PDF document.

Content-Disposition.description: Serves the PDF as an attachment named by the invoice number, as `attachment; filename="<invoice number>.pdf"`.

schema.description: Prague local date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm) or ISO 8601 instant.
Prague local date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm) or ISO 8601 instant.

200.description: The issued invoice as a PDF document.

Content-Disposition.description: Serves the PDF as an attachment named by the invoice number, as `attachment; filename="<invoice number>.pdf"`.

200.description: A cancelled invoice's credit note as a PDF document.

Content-Disposition.description: Serves the PDF as an attachment named by the credit note number, as `attachment; filename="<credit note number>.pdf"`.

CustomerPassId.description: Opaque identifier of a pass purchase order.

CustomerPlainDate.description: Prague calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

CustomerReservationOrderId.description: Opaque identifier of an order booked on the website.

CustomerCoworkStay.description: day (the arrival date's Prague calendar day) or overnight (noon on the arrival date to noon the next date, Prague time). Reserved Desk only.

CustomerInvoiceId.description: Opaque identifier of an issued invoice.

amount.description: Exact decimal amount in currency units, such as "258.80" or "280"; never rounded.

CustomerCheckoutUnavailableReason.description: expired: the hold or its token ended, start a new checkout. payment_in_progress: a payment for the order has started. price_review_pending: accept the changed price first. not_payable: the order's payment is in progress or it can no longer be paid, open its status screen. reservation_ended: the booked time has passed. offer_replaced: the cowork offer booked is no longer sold.

ReferralCode.description: Uppercase ASCII referral code in the shared promotion namespace.

CustomerVatStatus.description: Whether the seller is registered for VAT: a VAT payer's totals carry a tax note.

CustomerMeetingRoomDuration.description: hour:1 (one hour), hour:4 (four hours), or day:1 (a whole Prague calendar day).

CustomerStartTime.description: Prague start time in HH:mm, such as 09:00.

CustomerReservationInviteeId.description: Opaque identifier of a person invited to an order.

url.description: The payment provider's page to open in a browser.

CustomerReservationSettlement.description: Known values: paid, free, entry-pack. Clients ignore any other value.

locale.description: The account's saved locale tag, or null when none is saved. Clients ignore tags they don't support.
